title: Keloid fibroblast trajectory reproducibility package
description: Analysis code, frozen gene definitions, parameter records, supplementary data, machine-readable outputs, and public-data-derived processed inputs accompanying the manuscript A single-cell trajectory framework for fibroblast state remodeling and its association with postoperative recurrence in keloids. Raw single-cell RNA-sequencing data from the discovery cohort have been submitted to GSA-Human under BioProject accession PRJCA070046; further information regarding data access is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
